name: @w6w-apps/duda
description: Manage Duda sites, pages, form submissions, collections and accounts through the Partner API.

w6w.longDescription:
Duda is a website builder that agencies and SaaS platforms white-label: each of their customers gets a site, an editor and a set of hosted pages. This app is the Partner API front end for the sites those customers live on — listing and fetching them, creating one from a template, and pushing it live or taking it back down again.

It reads the page tree of a site and the contact-form submissions a site has collected, and it works with Collections — Duda's structured-data tables — end to end: listing the collections on a site, reading one's fields and rows, and creating, overwriting or deleting rows in bulk.

Accounts round it out, since a partner provisions the people who own those sites: an account can be fetched by name or created outright. Health checks track Duda's own status page and declare, as a positive fact, that Duda publishes no machine-readable quota. Both regions Duda runs — US and EU — are selectable per Connection.
